summary: Recent updates to **WebGPU**, a technology that allows high-performance 3D graphics and computation in web applications, focused on refining its memory management and resource handling. This included improvements to how the browser cleans up and manages certain classes of objects, ensuring more efficient operation and reducing potential memory leaks. These enhancements matter because they contribute to a smoother user experience in graphics-intensive applications, such as games and simulations, making them run more reliably and efficiently in Firefox.
